name: Acme Rewards
description: Acme Rewards is a Telegram Mini App where users complete tasks (subscribe to a channel, start a bot, open a Mini App, register, make a first action or purchase) and advertisers pay per verified action.
goodLeadCriteria: A good lead is a business or product that could pay for such actions: Mini Apps, bots, games, apps, web services, crypto/fintech products, exchanges, e-commerce, education, and also channels or communities that visibly promote themselves.
rejectCriteria: Reject only: personal blogs without a product, ad sellers/agencies/"buy ads here" catalogs, outright fraud (phishing, wallet drainers, pyramid schemes), pornography, drugs, pure news aggregators with no product, dead or empty pages.
queryPlanningContext: businesses that could buy user actions (channel subscriptions, bot starts, Mini App launches, registrations, first purchases) from a rewards Mini App
